notes.title: 📢 Release date of Feudal Baron: King's Land! 🎮🏰
notes.notes:
You’ve been waiting eagerly, and we’re excited to announce that Feudal Baron: King's Land will officially launch on October 23, 2024! 🌟

Get ready for an epic journey to the medieval era, where strategy, resource management, and political alliances will decide the fate of your kingdom. ⚔️👑

Mark the date in your calendars and prepare for an unforgettable experience!
